outcome: fetal malpresentation at birth (breech, transverse/shoulder and face/brow presentations)
cohort: The study included 355,990 singleton pregnancies born in Queensland, Australia, between July 2012 and July 2018.
finding: Breech presentation occurred approximately 20% more often in singleton pregnancies conceived via both Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) and Ovulation Induction (OI) compared to spontaneous conception.
